notes.title: Japanese Localization & Rakuen: Deluxe Edition Switch Release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27110155/9357cf6cc356edaf6806e9a96bfdd77a5dd7c254.png[/img]

🌻 Rakuen: Deluxe Edition (which includes Rakuen, Mr. Saitou and a 3D animated film collection) has finally been released on Switch!

🌻 Players will now be able to experience Rakuen in Japanese! An official Japanese version (localized by 8-4, with Keiko Fukuichi in charge of translation) has also been released today! 
ハチノヨンが日本語ローカライズを手掛けた、『RAKUEN』公式日本語版、遂に発売！

🌻 Don't forget to check out Mr. Saitou! A bite-sized adventure in the world of Rakuen where you play as an overworked Japanese salaryman who is spirited away to the corporate world of... Llamaworms. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/628740/Mr_Saitou/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31390/Rakuen__Mr_Saitou_Bundle/

notes.title: Five years after launch, heartfelt indie Rakuen is getting a 'major update' and spin-off
notes.notes: In 2017, indie developer and composer Laura Shigihara released Rakuen, a delightful adventure-RPG about a sick boy and his mother who travel back and forth between a whimsical fantasy land and the somewhat less whimsical hospital where he's staying. Now, Shigihara has announced that Rakuen is getting a significant update, and a new game in the same setting will be released next year... Read more.
